context.rework_reason: TEST-DESIGNER's step-03 handoff (findings_for_orch, MINOR severity) reported a real inconsistency: verify_outcome/2's :audit_event clause discarded `produces` and never ran `args` through the {{produces.X}} template-substitution mechanism the :task_assigned and :instance_state clauses already used -- a scenario referencing a prior step's captured output in an audit_event outcome's args (e.g. resource_id: "{{produces.instance.instance_id}}") silently matched nothing instead of resolving to the real id or failing closed.

task.description: Fix the :audit_event clause in test/support/simulation/runner.ex's verify_outcome/2 to run resource_id/resource_type through the same {{produces.X}} substitution mechanism the other two clauses already use, and add a real test exercising the fixed path.
acceptance_criteria: audit_event's verify_outcome/2 clause resolves {{produces.X}} references in resource_id/resource_type before querying Letflow.Audit.list_entries/1, matching task_assigned/instance_state's existing pattern

an unresolved {{produces.X}} reference in an audit_event outcome's args fails closed (outcome: :fail with the resolution error), same as the other two methods, rather than sending the literal template string to the query

a new or adjusted test proves a genuine {{produces.X}} reference resolves against real Postgres state and actually scopes the query (a mismatched resolved value must fail even when a real row for the right event_type exists)
mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean; mix format --check-formatted clean; all pre-existing simulation-harness tests (23) still pass

result.fix_summary: verify_outcome/2's :audit_event clause (test/support/simulation/runner.ex) now takes `produces` (was `_produces`, discarded) and runs resource_id/resource_type through a new resolve_optional_ref/3 helper before building the Audit.list_entries/1 query. resolve_optional_ref/3 mirrors the existing resolve_ref/3 (used by task_assigned's task_ref and instance_state's instance_ref) but treats a missing key as {:ok, nil} rather than {:error, {:missing_arg, key}} -- resource_id/resource_type are optional args on this method (Audit.list_entries/1 already treats nil as 'do not filter on this field'), unlike task_ref/instance_ref which are required. The clause body is now wrapped in a `with` that fails closed (outcome: :fail, observed: {:error, reason}) on any resolution error, exactly matching task_assigned/instance_state's existing failure shape.
result.test_added: Two new tests in the 'audit_event verification method' describe block of test/letflow/simulation/runner_template_and_outcomes_test.exs: (1) 'resolves a {{produces.X}} resource_id reference and scopes the real query by it' -- a real HTTP-dispatched instance-create step produces a runtime-only instance_id; the audit_event outcome's args reference it as "{{produces.instance.instance_id}}"; asserts :pass and that the matched real Postgres row's resource_id equals the captured runtime id (not hardcoded). (2) a mismatch pair using a resolved-but-wrong UUID, proving the substitution actually scopes the query rather than being a no-op that would pass regardless. The pre-existing audit_event tests' stale NOTE comment (recording the now-fixed gap) was removed since it no longer describes current behavior.

test_evidence.test_result: Result: 25 passed, 0 failed (23 pre-existing + 2 new audit_event template-substitution tests)
